title: A World Series Ownership Blueprint for the San Diego Padres
secondaryKeywords: how padres can win world series
audience: A prospective Padres owner or a friend who wants a serious, sendable memo on how San Diego converts capital and players into a first World Series—not a hot-take recap.
metaDescription: A buyer’s memo: franchise capital, player assets, peer gaps, and the operating plan to win San Diego’s first title.
angle: Treat ownership as an operating problem: inventory capital and controllable WAR, compare the championship asset stack to true contenders, then rank the gaps a buyer closes first.

dataSources.name: Forbes MLB valuations (March 2026)
dataSources.notes: Padres ~$3.1B / 10th; peer values for Yankees, Dodgers, Giants, Mets, Angels, D-backs, Rockies.

dataSources.name: Baseball Reference — 2024 Padres statistics
dataSources.notes: bWAR for Merrill, King, Cease, Machado, Tatis, and other core contributors.

dataSources.name: FanGraphs / Spotrac payroll summaries
dataSources.notes: Rounded cost markers for efficiency screening only.

distribution.linkedinHook: Forbes books the Padres as a top-ten MLB asset. The missing World Series is an operating problem—not a small-market excuse.
